name: shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mdo rkyang du bshad pa'i don yang dag par bsdus pa
provenance: Private collection of Tshul khrims rgyal mtshan
item_description:
Script: 'bru tsha.
Lines per folio: 6; 5 on fol. 8a.
Number on last folio: brgyad bzhugs so
Orthography:
- Numerals used for numbers 
- Frequent abbreviations (e.g., for thams cad, nyon mongs, etc.)
- Frequent additional suffix –‘a (e.g., dbye’, brda’, gzhi’)
- Bindu for m
- Always a tsheg before shad (or double shad)
